svg.title: Dictation Indicator for Voxtype in motion
svg.desc: A looping tour: a still Seed in the top bar while Voxtype is idle, a red trace and a Listening pill while it records, an amber sash and a Transcribing pill while it transcribes, then a check and Done before the pill leaves.

g.text: A still Seed in the panel’s own colour.
A red trace that follows your voice.
An amber sash while Voxtype works.
A check, then the pill leaves.
